qualifier: via PI3K, RAC1 and CDK5 branches
name: TRKB signaling through PI3K, RAC1 and CDK5
rationale: All members concern BDNF/NTF3 signaling through the NTRK2 (TRKB) receptor, and the theme is set apart from TRKA/ERK5, FRS2/PLCG1/RAS-branch TRKB and synaptic actin-plasticity confusables by its PI3K/AKT, RAC1 and CDK5 effector arms.

name: Convergent extension and neural plate morphogenesis
rationale: All members are convergent-extension cell rearrangements in gastrulation, axis elongation and organogenesis plus neural plate shaping, distinct from confusables about neural plate patterning, planar polarity proteins or axial mesoderm.

name: Protein repair and methylglyoxal response under cellular stress
rationale: Members are DJ-1-type stress-protective functions (protein deglycation repair, methylglyoxal metabolism, nitrosative and manganese stress, restraint of folding, mitochondrial targeting and chaperone-mediated autophagy), and protein repair plus methylglyoxal handling separate it from chaperone, aggrephagy, heat-shock and ROS-detoxification confusables.

qualifier: with BMP signaling and pulmonary pressure control
name: Pulmonary and great-artery development with BMP signaling
rationale: Members cover pulmonary, coronary, pharyngeal-arch and outflow-tract artery morphogenesis, ductus closure, lung blood pressure and BMP/SMAD signaling, which distinguishes it from valve, heart-chamber and endothelial-differentiation confusables.

name: Chromosome condensation and centromeric CENP-A chromatin assembly
rationale: Members are mitotic/meiotic chromosome condensation and CENP-A nucleosome deposition at centromeres, distinguishing it from replication-dependent chromatin assembly, histone acetylation and sister-chromatid cohesion confusables.

qualifier: by neuropeptide and opioid G protein signaling
name: Sleep-wake regulation by neuropeptide and opioid GPCR signaling
rationale: Members combine REM/non-REM sleep and wakefulness regulation with orexin/neuropeptide, opioid and dense-core-vesicle synaptic signaling, whereas confusables pair sleep with feeding, mating, aggression or stress behaviours.

qualifier: bacterial entry and SARS coronavirus host targeting
name: Bacterial host-cell entry and SARS coronavirus host targeting
rationale: Members describe Listeria and other bacterial attachment/entry and SARS-CoV-1/2 targeting of host signalling, junctions and cell death, distinct from toxin uptake, Mycobacterium phagosome subversion and RSV protein maturation confusables.

qualifier: steroidogenesis, thyroid, growth hormone, prolactin and leptin axes
name: Steroidogenesis, thyroid and growth hormone endocrine axes
rationale: Members span adrenal/gonadal steroid biosynthesis and its CYP defects, corticosteroid secretion, thyroid hormone handling and GH/prolactin/leptin cytokine-receptor signaling, distinguishing it from vitamin D, retinoid, vitamin K and growth-rate confusables.

qualifier: with lysosomal and Golgi membrane compartments
name: Glycosphingolipid transfer with lysosomal and Golgi compartments
rationale: Members are glycolipid, glycosphingolipid and ceramide-1-phosphate transport together with lysosome, Golgi membrane and lysosomal enzyme secretion modules, unlike confusables centred on glycosphingolipid synthesis, catabolism or phospholipid transfer.

core: Negative regulation of inflammatory cytokine production
name: Suppression of IL-1, IL-12 and Toll/IL-1R signaling
rationale: All members restrain IL-1 alpha/beta and IL-12 production or Toll and IL-1 receptor signaling, distinguishing it from confusables focused on IL-6/TNF/IL-10, TLR2/4 suppression or inflammasome activation.

name: Social, vocal and sensory-driven behaviour
rationale: Members are behavioural and sensory phenotypes (vocal learning, social interaction, touch, auditory, prepulse inhibition, grooming, exploration) with amygdala/striatum development and MECP2-GABA regulation, distinct from MECP2-molecular and locomotor/cerebellar confusables.

qualifier: replication, recombination and DNA topological remodeling
name: Telomere replication, recombination and DNA topological remodeling
rationale: Members concern telomere maintenance by recombination and replication, D-loop and t-circle handling, fork reversal and DNA topology change, whereas confusables emphasise telomere capping/packaging or R-loop and crosslink repair.

qualifier: IFN-gamma and IL-12 production, Th1 differentiation
name: Th1 polarization and IFN-gamma/IL-12 production
rationale: Members promote Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma, IL-12, GM-CSF and MHC II/dendritic-cell cytokine output, distinguishing it from confusables about IFN-gamma signaling responses, Tregs or CD8/MHC I programs.

qualifier: of tumor-suppressive cell-cycle and apoptosis targets
name: RUNX3 regulation and tumor-suppressor target transcription
rationale: All members concern RUNX3 regulation and its induction of CDKN1A, BIM and p14-ARF, unlike TGF-beta receptor mutant, CDH1 and PAX3 confusables.

name: Bone maturation and enamel-dentin mineralization
rationale: Members regulate bone mineralization, enamel and dentin formation, tooth eruption and chondrocyte development, distinguishing it from phosphate/vitamin D homeostasis and cementum/odontogenesis confusables.

qualifier: coagulation, platelet activation and integrin adhesion signaling
name: Coagulation and platelet activation with integrin adhesion signaling
rationale: Members span the coagulation cascade and its factor defects, vitamin K carboxylation, fibrinolysis and platelet activation, and integrin-MAPK/Rap1 adhesion signaling separates it from the eicosanoid-rich, vascular smooth-muscle and ECM confusables.

qualifier: factor VIII, IX and V defects
name: Intrinsic coagulation amplification and factor VIII/IX/V defects
rationale: Members are intrinsic pathway amplification and variants of factors VIII, IX and V, distinguishing it from confusables containing initiation, fibrin formation, fibrinolysis, VWF and contact-system members.

name: Presynaptic modulation of glutamate release and transmission
rationale: Members regulate glutamate secretion and dampen glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission presynaptically, distinct from confusables built on presynaptic ion channels, vesicle exocytosis machinery or GABA secretion.

name: Urea cycle disorders of ASS1, ASL and ARG1
rationale: All three members are inherited variants of the distal urea cycle enzymes ASS1, ASL and ARG1, while confusables cover OTC deficiency, ornithine transport or normal urea cycle metabolism.

name: Naive and resting B cell signatures
rationale: Members are B-cell-enriched and naive B surface signature modules, distinguishing it from confusables that add plasma cell, germinal centre, memory B or B activation programs.

core: Inositol pyrophosphate and nuclear phosphoinositide metabolism
name: Inositol pyrophosphate, nuclear phosphoinositide and polyphosphate hydrolysis
rationale: Members cover diphosphoinositol and diadenosine polyphosphate turnover, pyrophosphate hydrolysis and nuclear PIP/IP synthesis, distinguishing it from PTEN/AKT, nucleotide interconversion and inositol transport confusables.

core: Phosphoinositide metabolism and ER membrane organization
name: Phosphoinositide synthesis, lipid transfer and ER tubular network
rationale: Members combine compartment-specific PI/PIP and inositol phosphate synthesis with ER tubular network shaping and ER-Golgi/membrane lipid transfer, unlike confusables on phospholipid flipping, mitochondria-ER tethering or phosphatase regulation.

qualifier: growth factor, NF-kB, p38 and PI3K signaling
name: Immediate-early growth factor and stress signaling response
rationale: Members are early-response programs to external stimuli (NR4A induction, TNF-NF-kB, p38, PI3K-mTOR, growth arrest), distinct from AP-1, UV-response and TAK1-JNK confusables.

core: Toll-like receptor signaling to inflammatory cytokines
name: TRIF- and IRAK2-mediated TLR signaling to inflammatory cytokines
rationale: Members are TLR3/4/7-9 signaling via TICAM1/RIP1 and IRAK2/TRAF6-TAK1 including TRIF cell death, plus induced IL-6/IL-8/TNF production, unlike confusables on inflammasomes, IRF3/7 activation, NF-kB broadly or cytokine suppression.

name: De novo pyrimidine synthesis through UDP and UTP
rationale: All members are de novo pyrimidine nucleobase and uridine nucleotide synthesis, distinct from purine synthesis and pyrimidine salvage, deoxynucleotide and catabolic confusables.
